title: Patient 17's implant, cut from his leg and tested for zinc-64

tellings.quote: Like patient 17, terrifying. He didn't tell me that till after I saw it got cut out of his leg.

plain: A filmmaker, Jeremy Corbell, says that in the 2010s he watched an object being cut out of the leg of a man known as patient 17, one of the people who believe something was implanted in their bodies during encounters. According to Corbell, the man only told him his terrifying story afterward, and the object was tested for zinc-64, a particular form of zinc; he links the case to a surgeon who removed such objects, Roger Leir, and a researcher, Jacques Vallee. If true, it would mean physical objects of unknown origin are being found inside people.
